# UPchieve Changelog, week of Oct 17 to Oct 24, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Oct 24, subway Oct 23. These deploys carried the NTHS checklist, SSO, logger, dead-code, and admin work that last week's digest had as merged or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Run the chapter checklist from a Google Sheet, with each chapter's progress saved:** the checklist in Chapter HQ and the To-Do tab shows the sheet's sections, descriptions, due dates, and resources in place of the old NTHS actions list, lets a chapter complete, uncheck, skip, or un-skip an item, and "Do this next" passes over completed and skipped items ([high-line !2012](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2012)); the Vuex store and typed API client behind it ([high-line !2011](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2011), [high-line !2010](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2010)); the sheet loaded, validated, and cached, with the last good copy served if a refresh fails ([subway !3059](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3059)); sections with no active items left out ([subway !3091](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3091)); each item's status per chapter, as incomplete, completed, or skipped, with who changed it last and when ([subway !3060](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3060), [subway !3061](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3061)); progress from the old NTHS actions carried over as completed, without overwriting anything already recorded ([subway !3064](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3064)); an `NTHS_CHECKLIST_ITEM_UPDATED` PostHog event with the section and item for each saved change, and separate events for failed loads and saves so they stay out of the progress funnels ([high-line !2016](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2016)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Close the chapters that aren't renewing:** staff close chapters from `/admin/nths/close`, linked from Retool's Returning Chapters page, unticking any that should stay open, then see which ones closed; each chapter's close, the end of its memberships, and the release of its school happen at the same instant, and marking a closed chapter's school official skips it instead of re-affiliating it and emailing its advisors ([subway !3094](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3094), [high-line !2024](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2024)); a coach can't join a closed chapter, signing up through its invite creates the account with no chapter, the join page says the chapter has closed, a school a closed chapter released can found a new one, and the impact-path job skips closed chapters ([subway !3079](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3079), [high-line !2014](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2014)); `nths_groups.closed_at`, `released_at` on school affiliations, and an `nths_group_renewal_candidates` table ([subway !3074](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3074)), with `createGroup` returning named columns so the new column couldn't break chapter founding before the code deployed ([subway !3073](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3073)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Give an approved president 30 days to start their chapter:** after that subway refuses to create it, the create page shows the deadline, and once it passes the NTHS link goes to a page saying the approval ran out; the apply, pending, expired, and create pages share one layout, and the app says "Honor Society" everywhere ([subway !3082](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3082), [high-line !2017](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2017)); new copy on the expired, create, and closed-invite pages, and a coach who clicks Create after their approval ran out lands on the expired page instead of an error ([high-line !2021](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2021)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Stop removing members who save a non-high-school occupation:** saving an occupation no longer takes anyone out of their chapter, and the admin email about it is gone; chapter admins need the high school occupation to see member details, and a sole admin without it can leave ([subway !3084](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3084)); Chapter HQ tells a member without it what their profile says (nothing, or an occupation that isn't high school), links to fix it, and offers a Leave chapter button, whose confirmation says they can keep coaching ([high-line !2019](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2019)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Credit the member who shared an NTHS invite link with the referral.** Copied invite links carry the member's referral code, it survives the move from Join Team into volunteer sign-up, and Sign Up with Google sends it along. 🐛 [#737](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/737) ([high-line !2007](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2007)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Send coaches' tutored session count to PostHog from the client too,** so flag reloads after identify keep the `sessionsAsTutor` property. ([high-line !1985](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1985)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Start onboarding's background info from what the coach already gave.** The Background Information form starts from the occupations, grade, and school on the coach's profile, so a coach who applied to NTHS before onboarding doesn't have to re-enter them, or lose "A high school student" by leaving it unticked. A school preselected in the school search also stops showing a false "Required" after blur. ([high-line !1983](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1983)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Point the joined-team confirmation at the NTHS sidebar link.** It named the old "My Team" link, and the team name could come up blank because it read a `groupName` field that doesn't exist. ([high-line !2013](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2013)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 👀 **Make NTHS members, admins, and presidents targetable:** `isNthsMember`, `isNthsAdmin`, and `isNthsPresident` person properties in PostHog, from the user's active chapter membership, with president meaning the President title ([subway !3095](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3095)); the same three in SendGrid's contact fields, synced after each membership change ([subway !3096](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3096)); and in Gleap's custom data ([high-line !2025](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2025)). *Kasozi Wilson*

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- **Move requesting a specific coach from the cache into the database, ahead of launching it:** 🚀 the sessions table stores the requested coach and when the student opened the session to everyone ([subway !3075](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3075)); 👀 subway reads and writes that state instead of Redis, holds back other coaches' holds and notifications while the student waits for the coach they asked for, and texts the requested coach only if they haven't opted out of texts ([subway !3088](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3088)); 👀 high-line uses it, so a refresh still knows the student is waiting, and the "breakout" prompt becomes "open to all" and comes after 3 minutes instead of 5 ([high-line !2020](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2020)). Requesting a coach reaches 60% of students with at least one session ([`student-request-specific-volunteer-sessions`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/713196)). *Trey Stevens*
- 👀 **Show coaches and students the people they've worked with:** a My Students page for coaches, listing every student they've coached with their last session, where a coach can start a DM ([subway !3098](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3098), [high-line !2028](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2028)); each coach's latest session with the student for My Coaches, plus their public profile stats ([subway !3090](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3090)); one card for both pages, offering a DM to coaches and a DM or a session request to students ([high-line !2027](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2027)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Give each coach-student pair one DM thread, apart from session recaps:** ✅ a conversations table, with a row from the first message either one sends ([subway !3085](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3085)); 👀 a messages table for what they send ([subway !3086](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3086)). *Liseidy Bueno*

## Coach queue

Revise the request dispatch algorithm to offer a new session to a few coaches one at a time, the way a library hold list runs down, before it goes to every coach online. Earlier digests called this Session holds.

- 🚀 **Add a `session_offers` table to record each offer to a coach:** its outcome (accepted, declined, expired, withdrawn by the student, or not offered) and the scoring inputs and outputs for each coach, kept as JSON so they can be rerun through the matching to tune the weights. ([subway !3083](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3083)) *sammy nave*
- 👀 **Rank coaches for each request and record the offers without making them.** Online, eligible coaches are ranked by how long they've waited for a session, counted from when they came online or their last session ended, whichever is later. Each ranking is saved as a not-offered offer, to check against real data while the offer UI is built. ([subway !3089](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3089)) *sammy nave*

## API response contracts

A typed, tested contract for every API route's response.

- 🚀 **Install subway's `@upchieve/api-contracts` package in high-line,** from UPchieve's GitLab package registry, pinned to 0.2.0, with scripts to install the production version or an MR's preview, and the package's subpaths mapped to its type declarations. The NTHS checklist client is the first code typed on it. ([high-line !2009](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2009)) *Kasozi Wilson*

## End-to-end test suite

A browser test suite that drives high-line against a real subway, plus the work to make it run in CI.

- 🚀 **Stop dropping chat messages sent right after typing.** Pressing Enter right after typing into an empty chat box did nothing until TipTap caught up two animation frames later, which also made the chat e2e tests flaky. The send check reads the editor's text directly now, and the e2e `hasMessage` helper only matches sent messages. ([high-line !1990](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1990)) *Ben Wheeler*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Offer post-session messages after every session in Session History.** Both people now get the "you can still message" prompt after any session that shows in Session History, instead of only when both sent a chat message. A session shows there when a coach joined and more than a minute was tutored, whiteboard and doc work included. Sessions with a banned participant don't get the prompt, since their messages are dropped anyway. ([subway !3018](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3018)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Stop sending the sign-up password to `/auth/sso`.** The sign-up SSO buttons sent every form field, which put the password in the URL and in subway's session. Each role sends only the fields subway reads now, so an SSO account no longer picks up a password typed before clicking the button. ([high-line !1999](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1999)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Send `SESSION_CLOSED` to PostHog for each person in a session,** however it ended: the student, and the coach too if one joined. high-line's `SESSION_ENDED` only fires for whoever clicked End, which made a per-person funnel through the end of a session hard to build. ([subway !3093](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3093)) *Alex Rodriguez*
- 🚀 **Make PostgreSQL Anonymizer available on a local database,** to try out the security labels that will mask PII on the replica. ([subway !2986](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2986)) *Alex Lindsay*
- **Give subway's logger one typed signature:** 🚀 `logError` removed in favor of `logger.error` ([subway !3036](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3036)); 🚀 `/server/worker/logger` folded into `/server/logger` ([subway !3047](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3047)); 👀 ESLint added to subway with one rule on, `use-unknown-in-catch-callback-variable`, so `tsc` catches `.catch()` callbacks still logging in the old argument order ([subway !3046](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3046)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Make grand-central-station one pnpm workspace,** so each Pulumi project takes its dependency versions from a shared pnpm catalog instead of declaring its own. ([GCS !191](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/191)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🎁 **Add a `storage` Pulumi project to grand-central-station,** empty for now, for the S3 buckets and their permissions (none of our AWS resources are in Pulumi yet), and later the Azure storage. ([GCS !192](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/192)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Type job names and payloads from the `jobProcessors` registry.** The `Jobs` enum goes away: `QueueService.add` only takes a key of `jobProcessors`, its job data is type-checked against that job, and adding a job no longer means updating the enum too. ([subway !3081](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3081)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Keep the session bar on screen when iPad Safari shows the keyboard accessory bar.** On an iPad with a hardware keyboard, tapping the chat box or the document editor scrolled the session header (Back to dashboard, Report, End Session) off the top of the screen. Sessions on iPads get enough bottom padding to keep inputs out of the zone where Safari scrolls the page to make room for the bar. 🐛 [#719](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/719) ([high-line !1910](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1910)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Hide the screenshare button when the browser can't share its screen.** On phones it opened the screenshare rules, and after "I accept" nothing started and nothing said why. It's hidden in the document editor too. 🐛 [#746](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/746) ([high-line !2008](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2008)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Let a student reach every class they're in.** My Classes gets a home page and a right sidebar for moving between classes, after the nested navigation in Progress Reports, with Back always returning to My Classes. ([high-line !1965](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1965)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Send a signed-out user to `/login` from anywhere.** The API's 401 redirect was a relative path, so from a session page it could go to `/session/math/algebra-one/login`, which treated `login` as the session id and failed with a 500. ([high-line !1988](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1988)) *Trey Stevens*
- 🚀 **Throw when a repository write matches no row.** Twenty write checks in `server/models` could never fire, so an update that matched no row passed silently. Every write check goes through `ensureWriteOk` in `pgUtils` now, and a session report with an unknown reason gets a 422 before anything is written. ([subway !3056](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3056)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Stop the worker from failing when it ends a session.** It tried to tell open dashboards the session had changed, but the worker has no socket connection, so the call threw. It skips that now, which means a coach's list won't drop an unmatched session the worker ended until the next update. ([subway !3076](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3076)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Manage PhotoDNA's quarantine storage in Pulumi, and add private storage for its SDK.** The storage that holds the uploads PhotoDNA matched, and the grants that let subway write to it and reviewers read it, are in Pulumi now, protected so Pulumi can never delete them. Staging and production each get a private `photodna-sdk` container for Microsoft's licensed edge hash library, for subway to download at runtime, since it can't be shared publicly. Applied Oct 17. Part of 🐛 [#741](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/741), where an image upload got stuck loading. ([GCS !198](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/198)) *Chris*
- **Upgrade Node to 24.22.1 to patch [a remote code execution hole in its Brotli decoder](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/vulnerability/october-2026-security-releases#nodejs-brotli-decoder-out-of-bounds-write-permits-remote-code-execution-cve-2026-111497---high):** 🚀 subway ([subway !3097](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3097)); 🎁 high-line ([high-line !2026](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2026)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Get subway's CI ready for merge trains.** Manual jobs are skipped in merge train pipelines so they can't hold up the train, and the migration check still runs once, in the MR's own pipeline. Rebases take about a third of the time between approval and merge, and a merge train rebases and tests MRs in line on its own. ([subway !3077](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3077)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Steady two flaky test runs:** an NTHS groups route test built `joinedAt` with two `new Date()` calls, so it failed whenever the clock ticked between them ([subway !3078](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3078)); on a fresh `node_modules/.vite`, Vite found `VProgressCircular` mid-run and reloaded, which failed three NTHS specs every time ([high-line !2018](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2018)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🎁 **Show dollar amounts in chat as text, not math.** A message with two dollar amounts turned everything between the `$` signs italic, dropped its spaces, and hid the signs, for both people. The chat checks for real math nodes now instead of a pair of `$` in the text. 🐛 [#750](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/750) ([high-line !2023](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2023)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- ✅ **Store the person who filed a session report as its reporter.** Reports a student filed were stored as if the coach had reported the student. Only the session's student or coach can file one now. ([subway !3092](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3092)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Have a Clever or ClassLink user prove they own an existing UPchieve account before linking it.** Seven students in one class, joining their teacher's class through ClassLink, landed back on the login page because each had an email-and-password account whose email wasn't verified. Signing in with Clever or ClassLink when an unlinked account already has that email now asks the user to sign into it first, within 5 minutes, with its password or a code emailed to them, and then links the two. Accounts already linked still sign in on their own. 🐛 [#748](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/748) ([subway !3057](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3057), [high-line !2015](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2015)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Restart Clever and ClassLink tile logins despite a leftover SSO flow.** Students who had a failed or abandoned Google sign-in and then clicked their Clever or ClassLink tile landed on the login error page on every click, because the callback ran under the leftover Google flow. Tile callbacks restart as the provider they came from (Clever when nothing names one), and a repeated `?provider=` no longer returns a 500. ([subway !3072](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/3072)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Keep students the flag leaves out off the volunteer hours page.** They could still open `/volunteer-hours` from a link. A password login with a redirect does a full page load now, so students the flag includes still land on the page they asked for. ([`show-student-to-volunteer-hours-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/706824)) ([high-line !2022](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/2022)) *Ben Wheeler*

### Internal tools

- **Show admins the whole record for a student-volunteer:** 🚀 the last name on the admin detail page, which the query hid for anyone with a student profile, so photo ID reviewers had to go back to the review list to read it 🐛 [#716](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/716) ([subway !2894](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2894)); 👀 the volunteer's grade level in the review card's background info ([high-line !1927](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1927)); 👀 a chip for each role in place of the "Type" line, with the experimental-account banner and the "(primary)" and "(experimental)" wording gone ([high-line !1867](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1867)). *Macy Lam*
